page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Symbo!um" (the fifth letter looks like an l damaged by the scan, read as Symbolum[?]); "rcecitabat" (the first letters are smudged, read as recitabat[?]). Original printing: "suscipiendis" printed with long s; "alijs" and "peruigilijs" printed with j as a vowel; "atq;" kept as printed. The line ends "abfti-" / "neret," and "cele-" / "braret," were hyphenated in print and are kept. The fragment "dis," at the top is a continuation of the previous page's sentence.
